items.title: 为 cli flag 解析链补 fixture 覆盖
items.context: 覆盖 parseFlagsTest/parseFlags/coerce/addValue 的标准 flag、兼容旧 key=value、重复 flag 累积与类型强转。

happy.desc: 新增 cli-flags fixture 后，parseFlagsTest/parseFlags/coerce/addValue 的常见 flag 解析链可以通过同一个 black-box 回归跑通。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/cli-flags.json:4 WHY happy case exercises parseFlagsTest end-to-end across standard --key=value, repeated array flags, and typed object/number coercion. severity=info

edge.desc: fixture 能覆盖旧 key=value 兼容、--key value 与重复 flag 累积为数组的边界行为。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/cli-flags.json:21 WHY edge case locks legacy key=value compatibility, --key value parsing, repeated flag accumulation, and bare boolean flags. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 当值看起来像 JSON、boolean 或 number 但 schema 不匹配时，coerce 不会误转成错误类型。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/cli-flags.json:39 WHY adversarial case verifies current helper behavior of coerce/addValue directly, so helper drift is caught even without CLI dispatch. severity=info

items.title: 为 metadata cross-check 纯函数补 fixture 覆盖
items.context: 覆盖 task/checklist 双向校验的 happy、缺引用、done 但未被引用、空 task 列表等行为。

happy.desc: metadata-cross-check fixture 能证明合法 task/checklist 组合返回 passed=true 且 errors 为空。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/metadata-cross-check.json:4 WHY happy case proves validateMetadataCrossCheck returns passed=true with no errors for a valid task/checklist mapping. severity=info

edge.desc: 空 storyTasks 仍然返回 passed=true，不把 warning 场景误当错误。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/metadata-cross-check.json:19 WHY edge case locks the empty storyTasks advisory path so it stays pass=true rather than becoming a false blocker. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 缺失 checklist 引用和 done 但未被引用的 item 都会被明确写进 errors。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/metadata-cross-check.json:34 WHY adversarial case asserts both broken checklist references and done-but-unreferenced items surface in the error set. severity=info

items.title: 补回归验证 medium no_test backlog 归零
items.context: 至少证明 gap_analyze 不再报 cli-flags.json 和 metadata-cross-check.json 缺失，同时不引入新的 no_test。

happy.desc: 补齐两个 fixture 文件后，gap_analyze 不再出现 cli-flags.json 和 metadata-cross-check.json 缺失。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/metadata-cross-check.json:49 WHY happy regression checks gap_analyze no longer reports cli-flags.json or metadata-cross-check.json as missing fixtures. severity=info

edge.desc: 回归允许其他故事或别的 fixture 缺口独立存在，不会把无关 no_test 也吞掉。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/metadata-cross-check.json:62 WHY edge regression temporarily removes an unrelated fixture and proves only that unrelated no_test returns while target gaps stay cleared. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 如果未来删掉这两个 fixture 之一，gap 回归会重新看到对应 fixture not found。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/metadata-cross-check.json:82 WHY adversarial regression removes cli-flags.json and confirms exactly that gap returns, so future fixture deletion will be caught. severity=info
